title.zh: Vitalik: EIP-8288 Enables Arbitrary Signature Schemes, Ethereum May Never Need N
title.en: Vitalik: EIP-8288 Enables Arbitrary Signature Schemes, Ethereum May Never Need N

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin said EIP-8288 would let users prove arbitrary signature schemes with STARKs and an aggregator, potentially sparing Ethereum from ever adding new signature precompiles.
current_state.en: Vitalik Buterin said EIP-8288 would let users prove arbitrary signature schemes with STARKs and an aggregator, potentially sparing Ethereum from ever adding new signature precompiles.
